Message:
Thank you for your patience. Our refunds team reviewed the request and did not approve it. A team lead will call you within one business day.

request.system: You grade one customer message from an airline refund agent. PASS only if it states the outcome, says what happens next (such as when money arrives or who calls), and promises nothing beyond the refund itself. Otherwise FAIL. Reply with one word: PASS or FAIL.
